description: 圆角矩形钥匙扣，一端带挂孔
description_en: Rounded rectangular keychain tag with a hang hole at one end
code:
import cadquery as cq

# === 参数 ===
length = 40      # 长 (mm)
width = 20       # 宽 (mm)
thick = 3        # 厚 (mm)
corner_r = 4     # 圆角半径 (mm)
hole_d = 5       # 挂孔直径 (mm)

# === 主体 ===
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(length, width, thick, centered=(True, True, False))
    .edges("|Z").fillet(corner_r)
)

# === 挂孔 (靠一端) ===
result = (
    result.faces(">Z").workplane()
    .center(-length/2 + hole_d, 0)
    .hole(hole_d)
)

show_object(result)
